headline: Approved previous minutes and financial report; no other votes taken on projects or funding.
summary: The Methuen Council on Aging board approved the previous meeting's minutes and the financial report. The director reported on Center attendance, events, the A/C upgrade, and CDBG funds, and the board discussed the November 21st Santa Parade.

plain_text:
METHUEN COUNCIL ON AGING -  BOARD MINUTES of  
SEPTEMBER 25, 2026 
 
 
 
 
MINUTES TAKEN BY:  Stephen Alfano 
 
 
 
IN ATTENDANCE:   Ex.Dir. Susan Riccio; Chairwoman Maureen Sharrock;  Aura Fluet; 
Marylin Murphy                          
                                                                                Christine Metzmaekers (mobile); Stephen Alfano 
 
CALLED TO ORDER: Time:  10:05  By:  Chair Maureen Sharrock 
 
 
 
REFLECTION BY:   Maureen sharrock 
 
 
 
PREVIOUS MINUTES READ BY:   emailed prior, read by all 
Motion to Accept by:   Stephen Alfano   2nd:  Aura Fluet     APPROVED _Y_ 
 
 
 
FINANCIAL REPORT:      Submitted By:  Ex. Dir. Susan Riccio 
Motion to Accept:  Aura Fluet  2nd:  Steve Alfano      APPROVED  _Y_ 
 
 
 
 
 
DIRECTORS REPORT: (attach report) 
-395 additional participants at the Senior Activities Center in the months of 
June/July/August over last year – attributed to organized programs, speakers 
and continued outreach by the staff. 
-Center hosted a luncheon for the DPW to show gratitude for the job the great 
work they continue to do for the Center. Planned to be a yearly event. 
-One of Center programs in August was a Hoodsie day along-side dancing. The 
Store Manager, Dereck was invited, and did attend. All 100 participants enjoyed 
the event & seeing Derek. The goal was to bring in businesses that help the 
Center. 
- Beginning Sept 9th, extended hours thru the end of October go into effect. (See 
ad in Methuen Life) 
- Giving Tree for the Homebound goes up  Sept. 30th. Last year 63 seniors 
received gifts to know they’re not forgotten. This year’s goal is 100. 
-Thursday  Sept.27 Happy Hearts performed. Sunday performance cancelled 
due to weather. 
- Issue of A/C upgrade is diligently being worked on by Ex. Dir. Susan Riccio. 
Contractor T.B.D. 
-Excess CBDG funds for the now free MEVA will be allocated for Center 
upgrades. Nothing will progress until Ex. Dir. Susan Riccio receives confirmation 
emails from the Commonwealth of MA and Community Development.
-Graffitti removal was prompt with the help of the DPW,  who called the Sheriff’s 
Dept.  the Sheriff’s Department promptly sent out their Graffiti Unit. Many 
thanks to our DPW. 
-A faulty alarm zone was quickly replaced by Alarm Contracting, and the DPW 
again was on site to patch-up wall and paint the area. 
 
 
DISCUSSION:  Santa Parade is November 21st (Saturday) 
 
MOTION TO CLOSE BY:  Maureen Sharrock 2nd:  Aura Fluet    TIME:   11:39am 
 
 
 
 
NEXT MEETING SCHEDULED:  October 23rd, 2026  
 
SUBMITTED TO CHAIR BY: Stephen Alfano       Date: September 28th, 2026
